name: Troilus Grammaticus
bio: Troilus Grammaticus is one of the named epigrammatists of the Greek Anthology. Paton’s Index of Authors gives no date for him.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 55.

poems.title: Book XVI, 55
poems.author: Troilus Grammaticus
poems.text: A. Statue, who dedicated thee, and because of what, and to whom? B. The city to Lyron for his wrestling.
